definitions.explanation: The clear, viscous liquid surrounding the yolk of an egg, which turns white when cooked. Used in cooking and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {卵白|らんぱく}を{泡立|あわだ}てる。
メレンゲは{卵白|らんぱく}と{砂糖|さとう}で{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Meringue is made with egg whites and sugar.

examples.japanese: {卵黄|らんおう}と{卵白|らんぱく}を{分|わ}けてからそれぞれ{調理|ちょうり}する。
examples.english: Separate the yolk and white, then cook each one.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{卵白|らんぱく}を{泡立|あわだ}てる (whip egg whites)
・{卵白|らんぱく}アレルギー (egg white allergy)
・{卵白|らんぱく}を{分|わ}ける (separate the egg white)

USAGE NOTES:
The more common everyday term is {白身|しろみ} (lit. "white part"). {卵白|らんぱく} is the formal or technical term, used in recipes, food science, and medical contexts (e.g., allergy testing). Pairs with {卵黄|らんおう} (egg yolk).
